message.content: {"note_claim": "The video shows the 2022 Kerch (Crimean) Bridge explosion rather than the King Fahd Bridge.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "On 8 October 2022 at 6:07 a.m. local time, there was an explosion on (or near) the lanes of the road bridge, heading towards the Crimean city of Kerch.", "reason": "The page documents the 2022 Crimean Bridge explosion and includes CCTV footage of it, substantiating that such an event occurred and was filmed, though it does not mention the King Fahd Bridge."}

parsed.note_claim: The video shows the 2022 Kerch (Crimean) Bridge explosion rather than the King Fahd Bridge.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: On 8 October 2022 at 6:07 a.m. local time, there was an explosion on (or near) the lanes of the road bridge, heading towards the Crimean city of Kerch.
parsed.reason: The page documents the 2022 Crimean Bridge explosion and includes CCTV footage of it, substantiating that such an event occurred and was filmed, though it does not mention the King Fahd Bridge.
